customers_say: Customers find the water purifier delivers quality water that tastes great and is easy to maintain, with professional installation service included. They appreciate its reliability, appearance, and consider it a budget-friendly option, with one customer noting its premium matte finish. However, several customers report issues with water leakage from the unit.

reviews.author: Nikhil Shiv
reviews.title: Excellent Product and Service
reviews.body: Great product with excellent service. The water tastes much better, and the installation process was easy. Happy with my purchase and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Aishwarya Singh
reviews.title: A Good Product and A greater Service Experience
reviews.body: Using it for 3weeks no issue so far. installation process was seamless. I would recommend this water purifier for if nothing else then a great customer service experience like thats a novelty in india. also paying for a filter after 2 year is a huge plus and all consultation and maintenance service free for 2 years.

reviews.author: حافظ خان (Hafiz Khan)
reviews.title: Hassle-free, sleek, and great-tasting water!
reviews.body: I am absolutely loving the Native M0! The biggest selling point is the 2-year zero-maintenance promise—no more annoying calls for filter changes or expensive AMC contracts every few months. The multi-stage purification makes the water taste crisp and clean, and the sleek design looks fantastic in my kitchen. Installation was quick and seamless. Highly recommend this to anyone looking for a reliable, "install-and-forget" purifier!

reviews.author: Chauhan Vishal
reviews.title: One of the best RO.
reviews.body: One of the best RO i have purchased before this i was using another RO for my home. But all other RO required the service on every year and cost it around 4-9K depends. But Native say you have to service on every 2 year and warranty for the same.you can renew the contract again if you want biggest win. Water test is good. From bore we getting water around 800TDS and using this RO we get around 90-110 TDS 🤝 installation process is smooth
